arguments.value: Hyatt and Playa ended their prior master development deal and replaced it with a strategic alliance for Hyatt Ziva and Zilara all-inclusive resorts in Mexico and nearby markets. For a set period ending December 31, 2018, each company had a first chance to pursue new development opportunities in the market area before the other could proceed, and if a third party approached one company about a resort opportunity, that company had to introduce the other so it could try to win the management or franchise business. The agreement also sets out notice requirements, Illinois law and ICC arbitration in New York for disputes, confidentiality rules, limits on damages, anti-corruption commitments, and standard contract terms such as amendment, assignment, severability, and binding effect.
